# Responsive design (AP-RSP)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-RSP-01

**Large fixed pixel column widths** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Fixed widths of hundreds of pixels force horizontal scrolling on small screens.

**Fix.** Give priority columns flexible widths; hide or collapse secondary columns at small breakpoints.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenDataGridColumn\b[^>]*\bWidth\s*=\s*"[3-9]\d{2,}px"`.

## AP-RSP-02

**Side-by-side master-detail on narrow screens** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Two grids next to each other are unusable on mobile.

**Fix.** Stack or navigate between master and detail at small breakpoints.

## AP-RSP-03

**Dialog with large fixed width** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Fixed-width dialogs overflow small viewports.

**Fix.** Use relative widths or max-width, following the repository dialog options.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `Width\s*=\s*"[6-9]\d{2}px"|Width\s*=\s*"\d{4,}px"`; only when the file contains `DialogOptions|OpenAsync|OpenSideAsync`.

## AP-RSP-04

**Very large fixed inline width** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Inline widths over 1000px break layouts on anything but wide desktops.

**Fix.** Use layout components (RadzenRow/Column, RadzenStack) and relative units.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `style\s*=\s*"[^"]*\bwidth\s*:\s*\d{4,}px`.
